name: J. Kumar Infraprojects Ltd
title: J. Kumar Infraprojects Ltd - 532940 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR5,723 cr with Q4 down 3%; order book of INR18,554 cr plus ~INR6,300 cr year-to-date inflows and a FY27 guide of ~15% top-line growth, but bid discipline has left FY25-26 inflows weak.

capex.quote: around INR200 crores to INR250 crores for the next coming 2 years, that is FY27 and '28

triggers.label: Order inflow ~INR6,300 cr year-to-date
triggers.quote: we have already booked orders in excess of INR4,500 crores in fiscal year, with an L1 of INR1,770 crores, totaling to around INR6,300 crores

triggers.label: FY27 top line +15%, EBITDA 15-16%
triggers.quote: we are around 14% to 15%, which as we have -- with the type of order books that we have, our endure would be to increase it from 14%, 15% to 15%, 16%

triggers.label: Working capital days 112 → 99
triggers.quote: Working capital for FY26 stood at 99 days as compared to 112 days for FY25

triggers.label: Labour shortage 10-15% at sites
triggers.quote: there is a cut of around 10% to 15% of labor shortage is there at all our sites

guidance.quote: So this year, we are expecting a growth of around 15% in the top line.
our endure would be to increase it from 14%, 15% to 15%, 16% and the PAT would be around 7%
for this current year we expect order book close to around INR9,000 crores to INR10,000 crores for the full year
So around INR200 crores to INR250 crores for the next coming 2 years

red_flags.label: Dollar-target inconsistency: $1bn revenue target reframed, now 'one year behind'
red_flags.quote: as of now we are running one year behind our target, you can say that to us sir

red_flags.label: Order inflow gap of FY25-26 vs expectations
red_flags.quote: last 2 years, we just made INR2,500 crores and INR1,000 crores, which was much, much lower as compared to our expectations

red_flags.label: Management denies Q1 visibility on inflows
red_flags.quote: I'm not very sure about Q1. I wouldn't like to comment at this stage

evasions.quote: I wouldn't be very comfortable talking about the price of my TBM because this is a price -sensitive issue
I'm not very sure about Q1. I wouldn't like to comment at this stage
Honestly, I'm not very sure about that. So I wouldn't like to just make some false statement.
